question: List the names of all male superheroes with green skin who have more than 10 superpowers and are taller than 85% of the average height of all superheroes.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1."XCL_024" = T3."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_012"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Male'
  AND T3."XCL_006" = 'Green'
  AND T1."XCL_028" > 0.85 * (SELECT AVG("XCL_028") FROM superhero)
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018", T1."XCL_019"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4."XCL_013") > 10
